original: 女というものは、あなたがうまくやった１００ものことには気付かず、ただ失敗したことを暴き立てる、そういうことが出来る生き物だ。

en.text: A woman is not a creature that acknowledges the 100 things you've done right, but rather, one that without fail will point out the one thing you've done wrong.
A woman can be oblivious to a hundred things you did well, and point out only the things at which you failed.
